incidents.name: PancakeHunny HunnyMinter mintFor reward inflation
incidents.lossOther: 3.39 WBNB in this transaction; the exploit contract was run 91 times (PancakeHunny incident report)
incidents.notes: HunnyMinter.mintFor() sized the HUNNY reward from IBEP20(flip).balanceOf(address(this)) instead of the performance-fee amount actually transferred in, so a flash-loaned CakeFlipVault deposit minted an inflated HUNNY reward.

sources.ref: onchain review: HunnyMinter 0x109Ea28dbDea5E6ec126FbC8c33845DFe812a300 created 2021-06-01T03:31:00Z by 0xe5f7e3dd9a5612eccb228392f47b7ddba8ce4f1a, unrelated to attack sender 0x0ef50be29c82ecf2158ec1886dc6692a2b0db411; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events before the incident, age measured from deployment. Order-of-magnitude check: 3.39 WBNB moved in this transaction and the incident report states the exploit contract was executed 91 times, so the incident is well above the $1,000 floor. lossUsd converts only the 3.39 WBNB moved in this transaction: 3.39 WBNB x $397.53 at incidentTimestamp 1622687089 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $1,348; the full incident is larger because the exploit contract was run 91 times, but no per-incident figure is published.
